# package kcd

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-canbus/kcd"
```

Package kcd reads KCD files, the XML CAN database format of the Kayak project (namespace [http://kayak.2codeornot2code.org/1.0](http://kayak.2codeornot2code.org/1.0)), into the format-independent model of package candb.

Supported: Document (version, notes), Node, Bus (all buses are merged into one database), Message (id, name, length or "auto", interval, format, remote with a warning, Notes, Producer), Signal (offset, length, endianess, Notes, Consumer, Value with type unsigned/signed/single/double, slope, intercept, unit, min, max, LabelSet with Label and LabelGroup) and Multiplex with MuxGroup.

The offset of a big-endian signal is taken as the index of its most significant bit counted from the most significant bit of byte 0, the interpretation of canmatrix, which serves as the reference (see INTEROPERABILITY.md). Unknown elements and attributes produce warnings.

A LabelGroup expands to one value description per value. Groups of more than 256 values are not expanded, and at most 1048576 (2^20) values are expanded from LabelGroups per database; groups beyond either bound are ignored with a warning.

## Functions

### func Parse

```go
func Parse(r io.Reader) (*candb.Database, []candb.Diagnostic, error)
```

Parse parses KCD XML. Like dbc.Parse it returns the database, every diagnostic and, when any is an error, a \*[ParseError](#type-parseerror).

### func ParseFile

```go
func ParseFile(path string) (*candb.Database, []candb.Diagnostic, error)
```

ParseFile parses a KCD file. See [Parse](#func-parse).

### func Write

```go
func Write(w io.Writer, db *candb.Database) ([]candb.Diagnostic, error)
```

Write writes db as a KCD document with one bus. KCD cannot carry extended multiplexing (a multiplexed multiplexer, or a signal present for a range of values): such a database is an error. What KCD has no place for (attributes, value tables, initial values, node comments, signal groups) is dropped and reported as warning diagnostics.

## Types

### type ParseError

```go
type ParseError struct {
	Diagnostics []candb.Diagnostic
}
```

ParseError reports a KCD file that could not be parsed without errors.
